training.name: zeroshot/twitter-financial-news-topic
training.license: MIT according to the upstream dataset card; see data/training/SOURCE.md
training.nature: Public annotated English financial posts; historical, not a live feed.
training.processing: URLs removed for feature extraction; normalized exact duplicates and train/validation overlap removed. Pinned corpus checksums and measured results are in models/metrics.json.

demo.description: Fictional headlines created with AI assistance for repeatable demonstrations. Not used to train or evaluate the model.

portfolio.units: value and fxExposure in USD millions; duration and spreadDuration in years; rateDv01 in signed USD millions per basis point; equityBeta dimensionless.
portfolio.description: Original illustrative loans, bonds, equities and derivatives. No client or confidential transaction data.

liveSources.name: BBC News
liveSources.coverage: Global and financial headlines from BBC Business & World Intelligence.

liveSources.name: Twitter / X Financial
liveSources.coverage: Real-time verified market commentary, breaking stock news & macro alerts from Twitter / X.

liveSources.name: Yahoo Finance
liveSources.coverage: Real-time stock market, corporate earnings, and Federal Reserve updates.

liveSources.name: Presidential & Geopolitical Risk
liveSources.coverage: Presidential statements, executive orders, tariffs, sanctions, and defense/war intelligence affecting global markets.

liveSources.name: GDELT
liveSources.coverage: Optional with NEWS_SOURCE=gdelt; up to 20 English company headlines. Timestamp is observation time, not publication time.

liveTerms: Providers may delay or block requests. Public access does not transfer content ownership. Original URLs and timestamps are retained; exported live content remains subject to provider terms.

sentimentModel.name: Xenova/finbert
sentimentModel.use: Pretrained local sentiment inference, first 512 tokens. Weights are downloaded to an ignored cache and retain their upstream license.

topicModel.use: Locally trained TF-IDF and logistic regression; coefficients and vocabulary are bundled for JavaScript inference.
